title: refactor: share Gemini billing event parsing
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Unifies buffered and streamed Gemini billing output into one response shape and traversal.
- Replaces three copied reverse scans with one positive-usage counter factory.
- Preserves rule IDs, prices, provider fields, last-event semantics, and all exported billing APIs.
- Removes 11 net lines from the billing paths added by #12651 and #12839.

Tests:
- `enter.pollinations.ai`: 28 pricing-data tests
- `gen.pollinations.ai`: 23 usage-header tests
- Enter and Gen typechecks
- Biome

gist.headline: One scanner, less buzzing
gist.blurb: Gemini billing events now follow one shared trail instead of three nearly identical ones. The hive kept every rule, price, provider field, and final-event detail exactly where it belongs.
gist.summary: Unified buffered and streamed Gemini billing-event parsing in shared/registry/gemini-billing.ts, replacing three reverse scans with one positive-usage counter factory while preserving exported billing APIs, rule IDs, prices, provider fields, and last-event semantics.
gist.impact: Gemini billing paths now use the same response traversal for streamed and buffered output, making future maintenance safer without changing existing billing behavior.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy shared garden path represents one reusable Gemini billing traversal replacing three duplicated routes: Polli, wearing a tiny accountant visor, guides glowing usage tokens through a single signposted path into a retro terminal. Small code-plants and neatly preserved price tags symbolize unchanged billing metadata and APIs.
